data.name: CityPlaceOldTownDetail
data.value: Tallinn Old Town is one of the best-preserved medieval city centers in Europe, with cobblestone streets, city walls, towers, cafes, and viewpoints.

data.name: CityPlaceToompeaShort
data.value: A historic hilltop castle and parliament building.

data.name: CityPlaceToompeaDetail
data.value: Toompea Castle stands above the old town and is connected with Estonia's political history. Nearby viewpoints offer beautiful views over Tallinn.

data.name: CityPlaceKadriorgShort
data.value: Elegant park with palace gardens and museums.

data.name: CityPlaceKadriorgDetail
data.value: Kadriorg Park is a calm green area with Kadriorg Palace, art museums, walking paths, flower gardens, and quiet places for a city break.

data.name: CityPlacePiritaShort
data.value: A seaside area for walks, swimming, and sunsets.

data.name: CityPlacePiritaDetail
data.value: Pirita Beach is one of Tallinn's most loved seaside areas. It is a good place for summer swimming, long walks, cycling, and views of the city skyline.

data.name: CityPlaceBaltiJaamShort
data.value: A lively market with local food and street eats.

data.name: CityPlaceBaltiJaamDetail
data.value: Balti Jaam Market mixes fresh produce, cafes, street food, design shops, and local atmosphere next to the railway station.

data.name: CityPlaceTelliskiviShort
data.value: Creative quarter with restaurants, shops, and events.

data.name: CityPlaceTelliskiviDetail
data.value: Telliskivi Creative City is a popular district with restaurants, small shops, galleries, murals, events, and a relaxed urban atmosphere.
